title: Palindrome Partitioning III
description: Divide a string into k palindrome substrings with minimum character changes.
pseudocode:
1. cost[i][j] = cost to make s[i...j] palindrome
2. dp[k][i] = min changes to split s[0...i] into k parts
3. for k from 1 to K:
4.   for i from k-1 to N-1:
5.     for j from k-2 to i-1:
6.       dp[k][i] = min(dp[k][i], dp[k-1][j] + cost[j+1][i])
